Tests in store/test/user_test.go, store/test/user_delete_test.go, store/demo_seed_test.go, and various API v1 tests also call it.

Frontend tests, attachment code, and store test files such as user_identity may also call Store.GetUser. SQLite and Postgres UpdateUser methods call d.GetUser directly on the driver instead.
